headlines.title: Oracle Raises $10 Billion in Debt at Up to 8.65% as AI Financing Risks Persist
headlines.summary: The cloud infrastructure provider says its financing is secured and maintains its long-term free cash flow targets.

headlines.title: Oracle Insists It’s “Fully Funded” for OpenAI. Its Credit Default Swaps Disagree
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysOracle said on Friday, Nov. 20, that it’s fully funded for its OpenAI contract, days after its credit default swaps hit record wides.

headlines.title: Anthropic’s IPO Slide Is Bad News for Oracle, Which Is “Dependent on OpenAI”
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysAnthropic opened 34% above its $83 IPO price on Nov. 19, closed its first day at $97.

headlines.title: Bloom Energy Stock What Changed in AI Data Center Demand
headlines.summary: Bloom Energy has reported strong demand for its fuel cell systems tied to AI data centers, raised its 2026 revenue forecast, and secured attention through links to Oracle’s Project Jupiter contract and renewed AI infrastructure spending. The real story is the growing need for on-site power as data centers strain local grids, which directly aligns with Bloom Energy’s core business of providing fuel cell based electricity solutions for power hungry AI facilities.

headlines.title: Nebius & CoreWeave Jump 21% While Oracle Sees 12% Gains on Monday Following Jensen’s Return
headlines.summary: Eric Bleeker, Chief Investment Officer at 24/7 Wall St., says neocloud stocks rallied Monday on the return of Jensen Huang to NVIDIA. At 1:30 p.m. Eastern, Nebius Group (NASDAQ: NBIS) and CoreWeave (NASDAQ: CRWV) were each up 21%, IREN (NASDAQ: IREN) was up 25%, TeraWulf (NASDAQ: WULF) was up 13% and Oracle (NYSE: ORCL) was up 12%. Leading ETFs showed software up closer to 4% and semiconductors up 13%. Bleeker also pointed to two company-specific items. The New York Times reported that Anthropic's demand is so large that SpaceX needs new data centers by October to fill its orders. On Friday, Oracle said it has secured all funding needed for its OpenAI contract. Bleeker notes Nvidia helped build neoclouds with funding, technical expertise and chips. He calls it a one-day win. Nebius is down 38% over the past month, CoreWeave 12% and Oracle 10%. Over six months Nebius is down more than 50%, Oracle 40% and CoreWeave 55%. Bleeker names three drivers of the selloff: higher rates and wider credit default swaps, political worries after the midterms, and Huang's removal. Only the last has reversed. Going forward, watch the Fed's rate path and how politics affects project locations such as Texas.

description: Oracle Corporation offers products and services that build, run and support enterprise information technology frameworks worldwide. Its Oracle cloud software as a service offering includes various cloud software applications, including Oracle Fusion cloud enterprise resource planning ERP, Oracle Fusion cloud enterprise performance management EPM, Oracle Fusion cloud supply chain and manufacturing management SCM, Oracle Fusion cloud human capital management HCM, and NetSuite applications suite, Oracle Health applications, as well as Oracle Fusion Sales, Service, and Marketing. The company also offers cloud-based industry solutions for various industries; Oracle cloud license and on-premise license; and Oracle license support services. In addition, it provides cloud and license business' infrastructure technologies, such as the Oracle Database and MySQL Database; Java, a software development language; and middleware, including development tools and others. The company's cloud and license business' infrastructure technologies also comprise cloud-based compute, storage, and networking capabilities; and Oracle autonomous database, as well as AI, Internet-of-Things, machine learning, digital assistant, and blockchain. Further, it provides hardware products and other hardware-related software offerings, including Oracle engineered systems, enterprise servers, storage solutions, industry-specific hardware, virtualization software, operating systems, management software, and related hardware support services, and consulting and advanced customer services. It markets and sells its cloud, license, hardware, support, and services offerings directly to businesses in various industries, government agencies, and educational institutions, as well as through indirect channels. Oracle Corporation has a strategic alliance with Metron, Inc. The company was founded in 1977 and is headquartered in Austin, Texas.
